While the source URLs are not pinned to a specific commit (they use `/master/`), this is a common pattern for `-bin` packages that expect to pull the latest release assets, and the use of verified checksums mitigates the risk of undetected changes. No obfuscated code, suspicious downloads, or data exfiltration mechanisms are present.
</details>
